glvr.source: Greater Lehigh Valley REALTORS® MLS, pulled October 2026
glvr.sourceEs: MLS de Greater Lehigh Valley REALTORS®, consultado en octubre de 2026

notes: Pulled October 13, 2026 from the Greater Lehigh Valley REALTORS® MLS (Matrix). SALES: status Sold & Settled, settled 10/01/2025-09/30/2026; price = sold price. Property types = Residential sub type with category Detached, Semi Detached/Twin, Row/Townhouse, Row-End Unit, Apartment Style (condos), Cluster or Modular. Excluded: Manufactured (mobile homes), Resi Lease/Lot, and 13 GLVR listings with no category. Only GLVR's own listings (Association = Lehigh Valley MLS) are counted; records shared in from PMAR, Greater Scranton and Pike Wayne boards are excluded (most have no property-type code and about 1 in 5 repeat a GLVR listing). AREAS: the MLS Municipality field follows the mailing address (e.g. 'Easton' also covers Forks, Palmer, Wilson and Williams), so cities use MLS Areas instead: Allentown = Areas 13-16; Bethlehem = Areas 01-03 (covers both the Lehigh and Northampton County parts); Easton = Areas 77-79 (College Hill, Easton, South Easton); Nazareth Borough = Area 53. Area 17 (Allentown West-Parkland School) is outside the city and was left out. Counties use the County field. DOM: average of the DOM field across sales that have a DOM; sales with blank DOM (mostly builder/new-construction entries) are left out: Lehigh 143 of 3392, Northampton 147 of 2942, Allentown 18 of 862, Bethlehem 17 of 589, Easton 5 of 197, Nazareth 1 of 48. Values are unrounded. Matrix's own Stats screen counts blank DOM as 0 and shows whole days (22, 22, 22, 19, 25, 14 for Lehigh, Northampton, Allentown, Bethlehem, Easton, Nazareth). One Lehigh sale has a DOM of -22 (data error) and was left in as recorded. MULTI-FAMILY: Investment Property class, sold in the same period, GLVR listings, same city Areas, 'Total Units' field = 2 to 4. Listings with Total Units 0 or blank could not be classified and are left out (Allentown 5, Bethlehem 3, Easton 4). RENTS: Residential Rental sub type, Sold & Settled (lease closed) in the same period, GLVR listings, same city Areas, bedrooms exactly 2 or 3, leased price. Leases recorded above $10,000 look like annual amounts and are left out: Allentown 2BR 1 lease, Bethlehem 2BR 15 leases (mostly 2895/2897 Easton Ave), Bethlehem 3BR 2 leases. With them included, Bethlehem 2BR would be $1,840 on 167 leases (3BR unchanged at $2,000 on 110). Medians that landed on a half dollar were rounded up: Bethlehem 2BR $1,797.50 -> 1798, Easton 2BR $1,599.50 -> 1600. PRICE RANGES: Lehigh + Northampton combined, same sales as above (6,334 total = 3,392 + 2,942). medianSqft is Matrix's 'Square Footage', which is Total Finished SF (above + below grade). Above-grade-only medians would be 1192, 1332, 1500, 1865 and 2600. medianBeds from the Bedrooms field. PMAR (Part 2): left null. No PMAR MLS access; GLVR Matrix carries a PMAR data feed, but about 95% of those records have no property-type code.
